O!.text:
The default BPM is 120.
If you want to change it, replace the number in the middle with the BPM of your project. If you want to put the delay instead, remove the green blocks and put your delay value.

?i.text: In this and identical sprites you need to add design, animation and sound for first and second loops.

?j.text: To change the tempo (BPM) of the project, go to the stage tab and change the value of BPM.

?k.text: Sound for each loop plays automatically

?p.text:
Use these mouth and text assets to make animations and visuals for your mod!

Credits to @craftyvision and @IncrediFedor1825

?q.text:
All the icons are in the same sprite. You just need to insert your icons into the costumes. There are 3 icon positions for every sound: a - normal, b - dragged (have a shadow), and c - putted. 

ATTENTION: Do not change costume names, otherwise the project will not run properly

?r.text: Create a preview art so people could be interested in your project. To make it visible, just stop the project and save it before leaving.

jD.text: Sound for each loop plays automatically
